title: File:Ice Explorer vehicles on the Athabasca Glacier 20240824 1.jpg
author: DXR
sourceDescription: Two Ice Explorer (Terra Bus) vehicles on the Athabasca Glacier in Jasper National Park, Alberta, Canada. These specialized all-terrain vehicles are used in the Columbia Icefield Adventure to transport visitors safely onto the glacier. Equipped with oversized tires and a reinforced chassis, they are designed to handle the icy and uneven surface while reducing environmental impact. The Athabasca Glacier, part of the Columbia Icefield, is one of the most visited and accessible glaciers in North America. The image documents the vehicles and their role in providing guided tours in this prominent location along the Icefields Parkway.
